title: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude. Types suit reinforcement learning: a type constrains what an agent may choose, not how it chooses, so the guarantee holds for every policy a learner produces. We introduce epistemic typestates, a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning. An agent's type is a protocol whose states record its beliefs, the worlds it cannot rule out from its own observations and actions, and permits only actions that are safe in every world of the belief, whatever the others do within their public types. Agents learn inside their types, which are built and checked one agent at a time and run without communication. translated_title: 在类型中学习：面向安全多智能体强化学习的认知类型状态
translated_abstract: 摘要：类型规则使程序在构造上即安全：组件通过彼此类型的检查后组合而成的程序，不会出现类型所排除的错误。类型非常适合强化学习：类型约束的是智能体“可以选择什么”，而非“如何选择”，因此该保证对学习者产生的每一个策略都成立。我们提出了认知类型状态，这是一种面向安全多智能体强化学习的类型规则。智能体的类型是一个协议，其状态记录该智能体的信念——即依据自身观察与行动无法排除的那些可能世界——并且只允许执行在信念中每个世界里都安全（无论其他智能体在其公共类型内如何行动）的动作。智能体在类型之内学习；类型逐个智能体地构建与检查，并在运行时无需通信。我们证明了类型可靠性与团队安全性，给出了一个可靠且完备的类型综合方法，在可能世界为无穷时从守卫构建类型，并表明屏蔽器……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“认知类型状态”这一类型规则，让多智能体强化学习智能体在记录自身信念的类型协议内学习，仅执行在所有可能世界中都安全的动作，从而无需通信即可实现类型可靠性与团队安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces epistemic typestates, a type discipline that enables multi-agent reinforcement learning agents to learn inside protocol types recording their beliefs, taking only actions safe in every possible world, thereby guaranteeing type soundness and team safety without any communication.
